title: Epic Niagara Falls Private Tour w/ Tower, Journey & Boat Cruise
includes: Admission to Journey Behind the Falls
Admission to Niagara City Cruises (Seasonal, typically runs May 1st - Dec 1st)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on the Epic Niagara Falls Private Tour, the ultimate Niagara Falls adventure! This exclusive 4-hour private driving tour takes you closer to the Falls than ever before. Feel the raw power of Journey Behind the Falls, soar above the cascades at the Skylon Tower, cruise into the heart of the mist with Niagara City Cruises (Seasonal, typically runs May 1st - Dec 1st), and explore scenic wonders like the Floral Clock and Niagara Whirlpool—all with a friendly local guide and hotel pickup included! We’ll also stop at Maple Leaf Place to enjoy a complimentary maple syrup tasting.
